title: Integration of Aromatherapy and Essential Oils in Asthma Symptom Relief: A Narrative Review.
snippet: Asthma affects 262 million people globally, causing 455,000 preventable deaths, with higher mortality in low-resource areas due to limited diagnosis and treatment.
